strain: C57BL/6J background (mGlu5 KO and WT littermates)

age.evidence: Mice were approximately 4 months old at the time the experiments were conducted.

sex.evidence: Male and female mGlu5 KO mice and WT littermates were generated from heterozygous × heterozygous breeding pairs on a C57BL/6J background... For behavioral experiments, a total of 96 mice were used (Supplementary Table 1).

dosing.evidence: Psilocybin (1 mg/kg), provided by Usona Institute Inc., was dissolved in 0.9% saline solution, and administered via intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection... Mice were injected with a single dose of psilocybin 1 mg/kg, i.p. A subset of mice (n = 47) received a second injection of psilocybin (1 mg/kg, i.p.) or saline two weeks after the initial administration.

handling.evidence: No handling protocol described; only 'mice were acclimatized to the behavioral room for at least 30 min before testing.'

group_housing.evidence: mice were group-housed (2-6 per cage) with same-sex conspecifics of the same genotype in individually ventilated cages

day_night_flipped.evidence: in the 12:12 light/dark cycle (lights were on from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m.)... All behavioral testing was conducted during the light cycle (9 a.m. - 5 p.m.).

enrichment_housing.evidence: Home-cage enrichment not mentioned (only 'individually ventilated cages' and ad libitum chow/water).

assays.assay_description: Locomotor activity measured for 30 min immediately after psilocybin (1 mg/kg i.p.) or saline in a 27.3 × 27.3 × 20.3 cm Med Associates photobeam chamber; repeated in a subset (n=47) after a second injection 2 weeks later. WT vs mGlu5 KO, both sexes.

setup_habituation.evidence: Only room acclimation: 'mice were acclimatized to the behavioral room for at least 30 min before testing.'

setup_restrain.evidence: placing mice in a 27.3 cm × 27.3 cm × 20.3 cm photobeam activity chamber

food_restriction.evidence: Standard photobeam chamber; no food described in the apparatus during the 30-min session

water_restriction.evidence: Standard photobeam chamber; no water described in the apparatus during the session

time_to_assay.evidence: Locomotor activity was measured for 30 min after acute psilocybin administration

sample_size.evidence: For behavioral experiments, a total of 96 mice were used... Fig. 2: n = 10-14 mice per group.

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin increased locomotion in mGlu5 KO but not WT mice over the 30-min session; KO mice were more active than WT overall and male KO more active than female KO. A second injection 2 weeks later produced similar hyperlocomotion (no treatment × injection number interaction).
outcomes.statistics: genotype × treatment F1,88 = 7.22, p = 0.008, η² = 0.039; KO p < 0.0001, WT p = 0.103; sex × genotype F1,88 = 8.13, p = 0.005; male KO > female KO p = 0.018; second injection: treatment × injection number F1,39 = 0.194, p = 0.662; genotype F1,46 = 25.7, p < 0.0001; treatment F1,46 = 25.0, p < 0.0001
outcomes.evidence: psilocybin increased locomotion in mGlu5 KO (p < 0.0001) but not WT mice (p = 0.103).

B1_num_measures.evidence: Locomotor activity was measured for 30 min (single locomotion measure)

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Locomotion reported as a session total; no within-session time course reported

B4_ethological.evidence: Locomotor distance is not an ethological behaviour per rubric

B5_social.evidence: Individual testing in activity chamber; no social construct

B7_automated_classification.evidence: photobeam activity chamber (Med Associates Inc., VT, USA) — beam-break system

E2_shelter.evidence: No shelter described in activity chamber

E7_social_context.evidence: placing mice in a... photobeam activity chamber (individual testing)

E8_food_water.evidence: No food/water described in the chamber

D1_continuity.evidence: A subset of mice (n = 47) received a second injection... two weeks after the initial administration. Locomotor activity and HTR were recorded again

D2_session_duration.evidence: Locomotor activity was measured for 30 min

D3_recording_days.evidence: First injection day and second injection 2 weeks later

D5_followup.evidence: Both recordings occurred immediately after a dose; none ≥24 h after last administration

assays.assay_description: HTR video-recorded from above for the first 15 min after psilocybin/saline injection in the locomotor cell, manually scored by a blinded researcher; temporal profile analysed in 5-min bins; repeated in a subset after a second injection 2 weeks later.

setup_habituation.evidence: Only room acclimation of at least 30 min described

setup_restrain.evidence: mice were placed in the locomotor cell and were video recorded

food_restriction.evidence: No food described in the locomotor cell

water_restriction.evidence: No water described in the locomotor cell

time_to_assay.evidence: In the 30 min immediately after injection, mice were placed in the locomotor cell and were video recorded for the first 15 min following drug administration

sample_size.evidence: a total of 96 mice were used... Fig. 2: n = 10-14 mice per group.

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin robustly increased HTR; male mGlu5 KO mice showed a markedly greater psilocybin-induced HTR than male WT, with no genotype difference in females. Peak HTR at 5-10 min; second injection 2 weeks later produced comparable HTR with no sensitization.
outcomes.statistics: psilocybin main effect F1,85 = 160, p < 0.0001, η² = 0.563; treatment × genotype × sex F1,85 = 7.95, p = 0.008, η² = 0.026; male KO vs WT p < 0.0001; female KO vs WT p = 0.793; treatment × time F2,186 = 50.3, p < 0.0001; second injection: treatment × injection number F1,84 = 0.0732, p = 0.787; genotype × treatment F1,84 = 10.2, p = 0.002
outcomes.evidence: psilocybin-treated male mGlu5 KO mice exhibited a markedly greater HTR than psilocybin-treated male WT mice (p < 0.0001), whereas psilocybin-induced HTR did not differ significantly between female KO and WT mice (p = 0.793)

B1_num_measures.evidence: HTR count is the single behavioural measure

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: HTR temporal dynamics showed a significant treatment × time interaction (F2,186 = 50.3, p < 0.0001)... with peak HTR occurring at 5-10 min

B4_ethological.evidence: HTR explicitly excluded from ethological behaviours per rubric

B7_automated_classification.evidence: The behavior was manually scored by a blinded and trained researcher.

E1_environment_type.evidence: mice were placed in the locomotor cell

E7_social_context.evidence: mice were placed in the locomotor cell (individually)

E8_food_water.evidence: No food/water described in locomotor cell

D1_continuity.evidence: Locomotor activity and HTR were recorded again [after second injection two weeks later]

D2_session_duration.evidence: video recorded for the first 15 min following drug administration

D5_followup.evidence: Recordings occurred immediately after dosing only

assays.assay_description: 10-min test in Med Associates photo-beam arena (27.3 × 27.3 × 20.3 cm) partitioned into illuminated (750 lux) and dark compartments; measures % time in light, distance, latency to light, transitions. Baseline (~1 week pre-dose) and days 3 and 7 post-treatment.

setup_habituation.evidence: Only room acclimation described; baseline session was a recorded test

setup_restrain.evidence: allowed to freely explore both compartments for 10 min

food_restriction.evidence: No food described in LDB apparatus

water_restriction.evidence: No water described in LDB apparatus

time_to_assay.evidence: the LDB and Porsolt tests were conducted on days 3 and 7

sample_size.evidence: a total of 96 mice were used... Fig. 4: a-d n = 10-14 mice per group.

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin did not alter time in the light compartment or subsidiary measures (latency, distance, transitions) in either sex at days 3 or 7. mGlu5 KO mice spent less time in the light than WT.
outcomes.evidence: There was no significant effect of sex (F1,96.0 = 0.219, p = 0.641), treatment (F1,96.0 = 0.371, p = 0.544) or a sex × treatment interaction (F1,96.0 = 1.66, p = 0.200)... psilocybin did not alter any subsidiary measures

B1_num_measures.evidence: proportion of time spent in the brightly lit compartment. Additional parameters such as the total distance moved, the latency to the light compartment and the number of transitions

B4_ethological.evidence: Zone time and transitions are spatial measures

E1_environment_type.evidence: square photo-beam arenas... partitioned into illuminated and dark sections

E2_shelter.evidence: partitioned into illuminated and dark sections using a black Plexiglas divider; mice placed in the dark compartment via an opening in the top of the insert

E6_spatial.evidence: partitioned into illuminated and dark sections using a black Plexiglas divider

E7_social_context.evidence: Mice were placed in the dark compartment (individually)

D1_continuity.evidence: All post-acute behavioral tests were also conducted at baseline (3-7 days before drug administration); LDB on days 3 and 7

D2_session_duration.evidence: allowed to freely explore both compartments for 10 min

D4_baseline.evidence: Treatment groups were pseudo-randomized using baseline LDB performance collected one week before dosing

D5_followup.evidence: the LDB and Porsolt tests were conducted on days 3 and 7

assays.assay_description: 6-min swim in 2-L glass beakers with 1.5 L water (25 ± 2 °C); immobility in final 4 min quantified by Depression Scan (Clever Sys); latency to float also reported. Baseline session 5 days pre-dose; days 3 and 7 post-treatment.

setup_habituation.evidence: Prior to testing, mice were acclimated to the testing room for 30 min (room acclimation only)

setup_restrain.evidence: individually placed into 2-L glass beakers containing 1.5 L of water... with no possibility of escape (FST cylinder counts as restraint per rubric)

food_restriction.evidence: No food in the swim beaker

water_restriction.evidence: Water is the swim medium; no drinking source

time_to_assay.evidence: the LDB and Porsolt tests were conducted on days 3 and 7

sample_size.evidence: a total of 96 mice were used... Fig. 4: a-d n = 10-14 mice per group.

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin increased immobility time relative to saline at days 3 and 7, with no effect of sex, genotype or time. In females, greater psilocybin-induced HTR correlated with lower immobility at day 7.
outcomes.evidence: mice receiving psilocybin had greater immobility time compared to mice receiving saline (F1,96 = 6.73, p = 0.011).

B1_num_measures.evidence: duration of immobility; latency to float (Supplementary Fig. 6)

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Immobility quantified during the final 4 min as a total

B5_social.evidence: mice were individually placed into 2-L glass beakers

B6_cognitive.evidence: Stress-coping test, not a learning task

B7_automated_classification.evidence: automated tracking system (Depression Scan, Clever Sys Inc.) — commercial tracking; when in doubt score 0

B8_multivariate.evidence: Univariate models and bivariate correlations only

E1_environment_type.evidence: 2-L glass beakers containing 1.5 L of water

E7_social_context.evidence: mice were individually placed into 2-L glass beakers

E8_food_water.evidence: No food; water is swim medium only

D1_continuity.evidence: we conducted a baseline session, 5 days prior to drug administration; Porsolt on days 3 and 7

D2_session_duration.evidence: observed for a total duration of 6 min

D4_baseline.evidence: we conducted a baseline session, 5 days prior to drug administration

D5_followup.evidence: the LDB and Porsolt tests were conducted on days 3 and 7

assays.assay_description: PPI and pulse-alone startle measured in SRLAB startle chambers (San Diego Instruments) with 100 ms and 30 ms ISIs across prepulse intensities; baseline (pre-dose) and days 1 and 9 post-treatment. Full protocol in supplement.

setup_habituation.evidence: No apparatus habituation described in main text (details in supplementary file)

setup_restrain.evidence: using an automated SRLAB system (San Diego Instruments, USA) — startle chamber with holder per rubric

time_to_assay.evidence: PPI was assessed on days 1 and 9

sample_size.evidence: a total of 96 mice were used... Fig. 5: a-f n = 10-14 mice per group.

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin increased 100 ms PPI in females but not males and, at 30 ms ISI, normalized PPI in female mGlu5 KO mice to WT-saline levels, a sustained effect across days 1 and 9; no effect in males. KO mice had reduced PPI and startle; psilocybin did not alter startle.
outcomes.statistics: 100 ms: genotype F1,94.1 = 11.5, p = 0.001; treatment × sex F1,94.1 = 6.32, p = 0.014; females p = 0.013, males p = 0.288; 30 ms: treatment × sex × genotype F1,94.8 = 4.25, p = 0.042; female KO Psil vs KO Sal p = 0.020; startle: male KO vs WT F1,40 = 5.66, p = 0.022; female KO vs WT F1,49 = 10.99, p = 0.002
outcomes.evidence: psilocybin significantly increased PPI compared to saline in females (p = 0.013) but not males (p = 0.288)... female mGlu5 KO mice that received psilocybin had significantly greater PPI compared to female KO mice that received saline (p = 0.020).

B1_num_measures.evidence: PPI at 100 ms ISI, PPI at 30 ms ISI, and pulse-alone startle amplitude

B4_ethological.evidence: PPI startle magnitude excluded per rubric

B7_automated_classification.evidence: automated SRLAB system — startle transducer, not behavioural classifier

E1_environment_type.evidence: automated SRLAB system (San Diego Instruments, USA)

D1_continuity.evidence: Baseline PPI... collected before treatment... PPI was assessed on days 1 and 9

D2_session_duration.evidence: not reported (session length in supplementary file only)

D4_baseline.evidence: Baseline PPI and Porsolt test data were also collected before treatment... presented in Supplementary Fig. 5

D5_followup.evidence: PPI was assessed on days 1 and 9

judge_notes: All three candidates identified the same 5 behavioural assays (locomotor, HTR, LDB, Porsolt, PPI); c-Fos immunohistochemistry excluded as non-behavioural.
Locomotor and HTR kept as separate assays (different measures/recording windows) although recorded in the same chamber, consistent with all candidates.
Corrected gemma's internally inconsistent B1 scores (value '1' scored 1; PPI '2-3' scored 2) to rubric-consistent scores; LDB B1 = 4 measures → 4-6.
D2 for locomotor (30 min) and HTR (15 min) set to 15–60 min (score 1); gemma's <15 min was incorrect given the inclusive 15-min boundary.
D5 for locomotor/HTR set to 0 (majority): the second recording followed a second dose immediately, not ≥24 h after the last dose.
D5 for LDB/Porsolt set to 1 (days 3 and 7 post-dose), overriding gemma.
Porsolt and PPI setup_restrain set to 'yes' per rubric (FST cylinder; startle chamber holder), majority of candidates.
Porsolt B7 = 0: Clever Sys Depression Scan treated as commercial tracking (rubric 'when in doubt, score 0').
PPI session duration not given in main text → D2 score 0, low confidence.
